chapter: C.L. Burke and Kid Ory years
title: The Beverly Cavern changes hands
summary: The club is sold to Al Dietz, who keeps the band if the crowd stays.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: (Side A of Tape 2 ended at this point. Transcript will continue with Side B.)
(Side B of Tape 2 begins at this point.)
Yes. We stayed there until the joint changed hands; he sold it to a man named Al Dietz.
I can remember the night that he took over, it was on a Saturday night.
Why don't you tell us about that experience.

Well, I didn't know whether he was going to keep us or what so I went up to him and asked him, what about us. I said, do you intend for us to stay? He said well, if the crowd stays like this don't worry about it.
That was nice to hear, wasn't it?
Yes. We stayed there for a while.
That was quite a nice little run there, wasn't it?
